value.rationale: Quadratic-residue spectra are canonical arithmetic masks for Fourier analysis; their exact induced bounded-variation norm on cyclic real signals is a natural invariant, not arbitrary parameter slicing. The precise nonresidue extremizer and sqrt(p) amplification show a structural instability absent from Euclidean projection/shrinkage theory; a finite nonlinear witness transfers the invariant to a standard denoising nonlinearity. This is a complete formula over infinitely many primes and a meaningful sharp stability obstruction, despite classical Gauss-sum ingredients.
